pages.title: Knowledge Has Form
pages.text: A mathemagician does not learn merely by holding an object. The $(item)Field Ledger$(), crafted from a writable book and Rune Chalk, records materials used in successful proofs, epiphanies completed through practice, and discoveries read in the world.$(br2)Use it to inspect progress, routes, and granted constructions.

pages.title: Harmonic Practice
pages.text: To seek $(thing)Harmonic Correspondence$(), successfully cast twice with $(item)Feather$() prepared in the proof and twice with $(item)Nether Quartz$().$(br2)The two materials belong to different tiers. Motion and resonance together reveal sine, cosine, their Laboratory Forms, and $(thing)Harmonic Step$().

pages.title: Field Discoveries
pages.text: Some constructions survive as manuscripts in village chests. Cartographers may preserve $(thing)The Rotated Horizon$(), $(thing)The Bound Measure$(), or $(thing)The Ledger Of Remainders$().$(br2)Each record reveals a construction and may point toward a later epiphany. Reading never consumes the manuscript.

pages.title: Conjectures
pages.text: A locked catalog row remains visible as a conjecture. Hover it to learn which epiphany or field discovery gives a route to construction.$(br2)Knowledge limits inscription and editing, never the execution of an older valid talisman.
